job.job_title: Graph RAG Developer - Contractual - PAN INDIA
job.job_description:
We are looking for Graph RAG Developer on Protiviti Payroll for our client .

One Year Contractual Role - Extendable

Apply if you have Immediate to 15 days Notice




Role overview

We are seeking a Graph RAG Developer with strong expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Graph RAG, and Graph Databases to design and build intelligent, context-aware AI applications. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience implementing Graph RAG architectures using graph databases such as Neo4j, TigerGraph, or Amazon Neptune. Strong understanding of LLM orchestration, vector databases, knowledge graphs, retrieval pipelines, and multi-agent frameworks is essential. The role requires deep knowledge of AI system architecture, scalable solution design, and end-to-end implementation of enterprise-grade GenAI applications. Experience with Python, LangChain/LlamaIndex, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) is highly preferred.
